nom: celimax The Real Noni Moisture Balancing Toner

avis.texte: Purchased this toner for my teenage daughter who’s been dealing with some acne on her forehead. She’s been using it consistently for a few weeks now, and we’ve noticed some visible improvements, less redness and fewer new breakouts. It seems promising so far, but it’s still a bit early to make a final judgment. We’ll continue monitoring and update this review in a few weeks once we have a better idea of the long-term results.

As a hydration + barrier support step after cleansing, this toner is a solid addition: it will help prep your skin, boost nutrient intake (noni + amino acids), and support barrier recovery. Given your interest in skin health and professional mindset, this toner aligns well: high-quality formula, good ingredient transparency, and fits layering routines (e.g., multi-layer toners, 3-skin/5-skin methods) which you may already be using. If you have periods of dryness, this toner won’t replace a rich moisturizer or targeted treatment, but it will enhance your routine by improving how your skin responds to those treatments.

avis.titre: Good Part of Your Skincare Routine
avis.texte: The celimax Noni Moisture Balancing Toner is a good gentle toner that removes any last traces of dirt, grime, and impurities stuck in your pores after you wash your face. The toner is gentle on the skin and I liked how it didn't cause any sort of tingling, burning, or irritation as some toners can do. It didn't dry out my skin and did a good job of getting those last bits of makeup and dirt off my face - each time I used it, my cotton pads always had a bit of residue from my face taken off of it. The scent is very mild and doesn't linger very long after your skin is dry. This is an excellent toner that I would likely get again.

avis.titre: Could do without the scent but toner leaves skin refreshed and balanced
avis.texte: I’m a big fan of applying toner right after cleansing my face, and this balancing toner has been an excellent addition to my routine. It’s incredibly gentle and feels refreshing – however, I noticed it does leave a slightly tacky feel to my skin after applying. Then again, once I apply a serum or two and a moisturizer, I’ve already forgotten about the tackiness, making it a non-issue for me personally but still worth mentioning. I was intrigued by the inclusion of noni in the formula, and whether or not it’s truly effective – who knows – but so far so good in not causing any irritation to my sensitive skin. Bonus points for the generous sizing also; this bottle will last me a while even with daily use. One thing I don’t love about this toner is the fragrance, but to be honest, it dissipates rather quickly. Overall, a high-quality skincare essential!

For reference, I have dry to normal skin and I am not prone to breakouts. I do use a low percent tretinoin a couple times a week, and my skin gets dry, particularly around my chin and nose. I keep my skin routine pretty simple and had never used a toner before trying this, but it has been a really nice addition to my routine. It does have a bit of an astringent, herbal, minty odor when you first apply it to the cotton round, but the smell is not detectable when you apply it to your skin. I was nervous it would dry me out (flashbacks to the atrocious stridex pads of my teen years), but it was really cooling and soothing on my skin. I let it dry for a few minutes and then apply my face lotion as usual and my skin feels nice and moisturized in the morning.

avis.titre: Nice Quality But a Bit Expensive
avis.texte: I had an opportunity to try the 5.07 fl. oz. bottle of CELIMAX Noni Moisture Balancing Toner. I try to use toner on my face every day after cleansing. This one has a light but pleasant herbal scent. It makes my face feel clean and refreshed after using. The bottle is clear plastic with a plastic cap. There was a foam cover on the lip of the bottle when I opened it. It wasn't hermetically sealed but it did a good enough job to stop the toner from spilling out. I think it is expensive for toner where the first ingredient is water, costing $25 at the time of writing this review. There is no indication of when it was manufactured but it has an expiration date of December 2026. It is a nice quality so I would recommend if you don't mind the cost. Made in Korea.

The celimax Noni Moisture Balancing Toner is a nice light, and refreshing toner. It is a good sized bottle and should last a while. It has virtually no scent and goes on smoothly. It gave my skin some good moisture. I like this toner and the refreshing feeling it gives my skin.
